title: Calibration-free IMU-based Relative Orientation Estimation under Dynamic Human Motion
title_zh: 动态人体运动下无校准的基于IMU的相对方向估计
abstract: Recent magnetometer-free inertial measurement unit (IMU) methods can reduce drift in joint motion estimation using rigid-body constraints, but they typically require pre-calibrated sensor locations, assumptions of specific joint models (e.g., hinge joints) or limited motion types, or an external reference for global orientation. Furthermore, challenges related to high-frequency impacts (e.g. at foot strikes during gait) and numerical differentiation of noisy measurements have not been explicitly addressed. We propose an extended Kalman filter that estimates relative IMU orientation and sensor location simultaneously, requiring neither offline sensor location calibration nor a global orientation anchor. A systematic simulation study shows that the quality of the relative orientation and the sensor location estimates depends on different motion-intensity sources: the joint center acceleration and the relative angular velocity, respectively. A low-pass filter (LPF) is used to mitigate real-signal outliers before applying the rigid-body constraint. When applied to the OpenSense dataset with real IMU measurements across four subjects with three lower-body joint types during walking and complex tasks including various motion types, the proposed method achieves an overall relative orientation error of 2.61°, compared with 10.40° for a baseline using offline-estimated sensor locations and 7.43° for a baseline using marker-derived sensor locations. These results show that the proposed calibration-free estimation framework handles real IMU data effectively and achieves accurate relative orientation without offline sensor location calibration.
abstract_zh: 近期无磁力计的惯性测量单元（IMU）方法可以利用刚体约束减少关节运动估计中的漂移，但这些方法通常需要预先校准传感器位置、假设特定的关节模型（如铰链关节）或有限的运动类型，或者需要外部参考来获得全局方向。此外，高频冲击（例如步态中的足部触地）和噪声测量的数值微分相关挑战尚未被明确解决。我们提出了一种扩展卡尔曼滤波器，同时估计相对IMU方向和传感器位置，既不需要离线传感器位置校准，也不需要全局方向锚点。系统的仿真研究表明，相对方向和传感器位置估计的质量分别取决于不同的运动强度来源：关节中心加速度和相对角速度。在应用刚体约束之前，使用低通滤波器（LPF）来减轻真实信号中的异常值。当应用于OpenSense数据集时，该数据集包含四个受试者在步行和包括各种运动类型的复杂任务中的真实IMU测量，涉及三种下肢关节类型，所提出的方法实现了2.61°的整体相对方向误差，而使用离线估计传感器位置的基线为10.40°，使用标记点衍生传感器位置的基线为7.43°。这些结果表明，所提出的无校准估计框架有效地处理了真实IMU数据，并在没有离线传感器位置校准的情况下实现了准确的相对方向。
tldr_zh: 提出无校准EKF方法，同时估计IMU相对方向和位置，误差显著降低。
cover_zh: 无需校准！这个IMU方法让相对方向估计误差大幅降低
